title: DAY OF THE TENTACLE
subtitle: LucasArts, 1993 · the non-interactive demo, on ScummVM 0.6.1's SCUMM engine (v6), without its speech
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its name. Other switches of 0.6.1: -g<scaler> (normal, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f for full screen, -m<volume> for the music, -s<volume> for the sound effects, -n for no subtitles.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: dott-demo/ from dott-dos-ni-demo-en.zip, the demo the ScummVM project distributes

_why: A SCUMM v6 game on the same build. Its speech file is left out: ScummVM 0.6.1 asserts on it (sound/voc.cpp:125), natively as here. Held to a native g++ build frame by frame (gate-scummvm).
